An analysis of the company's Q2 2026 financial profile reveals severe balance sheet distress, highlighted by negative shareholders' equity of -$8,465M, accumulated deficits (retained earnings of -$8,881M), and a working capital deficit (current ratio of 0.92). While the company remains operating- and net-income positive in the short term, the deeply insolvent capital structure (total liabilities exceeding total assets by nearly $8.5B) points to a highly leveraged, speculative-grade profile with elevated default risk. Consequently, the issuer exhibits substantial credit risk, placing it deep into the speculative "junk" tiers.

DECISION: B-
